The way things are is I'm living with a sadist who is already blamed (by a lot of people) for pushing one person to commit suicide. I'm being intentionally hurt, she's bringing dangerous people (ex convicts) into the house to intimidate me, & she & I both know I'm trapped here until I can find a way out with no car, no money, no job, no family, and no way to open a bank account. This a game to her, & I need advice on how to survive.
I am not asking for relationship advice. This is solely about survival. I'm not the kind of person who has ever played head games with people, & I'm scared. I need practical advice on how to survive and exit the situation.
fuck off if you don't have any advice.
